ModMetaData.name: Settlement Lords (Community)
ModMetaData.author: justty32
ModMetaData.description:
Romance-of-the-Three-Kingdoms flavour for Rim War: NPC settlements get named governing lords.

- NPC settlements tracked by Rim War are gradually appointed a named lord with Polity and Loyalty stats (Named Officers foundation layer).
- A capable lord accelerates the settlement's Rim War point growth; an incompetent one drains it until the city dwindles to its floor. Applied per settlement; faction-level growth stats are never touched.
- The settlement inspect pane shows the lord and a governance summary.
- Lords step down when their city is destroyed or changes hands (an event is broadcast for future rebellion mods to consume).

Requires Harmony, Rim War and Named Officers (Community). Safe to add to existing saves.
